1433501715240783873.a: Ground stuff is going to be affected by induced electron flows in long wires and other large metal objects. Grounding/cages may help some things. In unshielded transformers that will burn out windings. There are not enough replacement transformers in the world to fix a country.

1433501717442797571.a: Satellites have an entirely different problem having no magnetic shield: Proton bombardment. They deal with this 24/7 anyway at background levels. Modern electronics used in sats are hardened against protons. It only takes one part that isn't but many should be fine.
